_comment: S47/S48 (ADR-145): the card rating — generated by pnpm rating:build from pnpm rating:run (analysis/runs, local). rating = prior(tier) + 0.5 × ½(presence′/σP + lift′/σL); see world/rating-build-cli.ts. presence and lift are raw win-rate differences; seen is the sample behind lift and castWhenDrawn. S73a (v1.7): the WHOLE table rebuilt on pilot 177 (runs authored177, sealed177, noise177, draft177; the Peasant columns from the 2026-11-19 Peasant run). v1.5 and v1.6 carried rows measured under three bugs in books 174 and 175 (Dungrove Elder was cast 25% of the times it was drawn; land searches were priced at nothing) — repaired in S73a. The Limited builder and drafter read a hybrid card by castableWith (concern 69). The cards the Limited runs saw under 100 times are re-measured by forced inclusion (run.limited.forced).
